name: List All Charges
description: Returns all open charges for all occupants residing at the property.

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by charge ID. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] or [PropertyId].

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by property ID. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] or [PropertyId].

responseFields.name: data[].AmountDue
responseFields.description: The current amount outstanding, and/or future amounts not yet paid.

responseFields.name: data[].ChargedOn
responseFields.description: ChargedOn dates from the past indicate an outstanding charge(s) that have not yet been paid that are "owed." ChargedOn dates in the future indicate upcoming charge(s) during the next monthly period.

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief summary or description of the charge.

responseFields.name: data[].GlAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the General Ledger Account associated with the charge.

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy associated with the charge.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses.
